title: Carousel
description: Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrow keys, buttons or dots (CSS scroll-snap, no library). Phones show one slide and a peek of the next.
when: Product photos, featured items, onboarding steps.
a11y: aria-roledescription="carousel" with a label; slides are labelled groups (“2 / 5”); the track is focusable and ←/→ move; no auto-play.
